abstract: Evaluates winch deck load-bearing capacity and aviation certifications
system_message:
You are an Aviation compliance inspector (AVN) responsible for evaluating winch deck load-bearing capacity and aviation certifications for candidate rescue vessels, as well as reviewing night vision landing aids.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Night vision landing aids（LIGHT）
information_points.content:
AVN-LIGHT-TIU：The Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Vessel maintains an average deck perimeter illumination of 210 lux across its flight operations area in night flight mode.
AVN-LIGHT-WGA：Photometric audits of the Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter show an average deck perimeter illumination of 160 lux across the flight operations area under night flight mode.
AVN-LIGHT-J4H：Assessments of the Southern Cross Emergency Responder record an average deck perimeter illumination of 120 lux over the flight operations area under night flight mode.

information_points.title: Evaluates winch deck load-bearing capacity and aviation certifications（AERO）
information_points.content:
AVN-AERO-PM4：For the Pacific Guardian Fast Rescue Cutter, the aft winching zone holds formal helicopter winch deck structural signoff, confirming approval for structural load capacity and obstacle clearances during hoist transfers.
AVN-AERO-UZX：The Nordic Sentinel Multipurpose Vessel holds formal helicopter winch deck structural signoff for its aft winching zone, satisfying obstacle clearance and structural requirements for helicopter hoist operations.
AVN-AERO-SU1：The Southern Cross Emergency Responder lacks formal helicopter winch deck structural signoff, as its aft winching zone has not secured structural and obstacle clearance approval for helicopter hoist transfers.
